# Kenton County Commonwealth's Attorney — Rob Sanders

> The online office of the Commonwealth's Attorney for Kentucky's 16th Judicial Circuit. The office, led by Rob Sanders, prosecutes all felonies in Kenton County, Kentucky, and publishes case news and a weekly newsletter to keep residents informed.

Office: Kenton County Administration Building, 1840 Simon Kenton Way, Suite 2300, Covington, KY 41011 · (859) 292-6580 · rsanders@prosecutors.ky.gov

## About
- [About the office](https://kentonprosecutor.org/about): Overview and a letter from Rob Sanders
- [Rob Sanders](https://kentonprosecutor.org/about/rob-sanders): Biography of the Commonwealth's Attorney
- [Assistant Commonwealth's Attorneys](https://kentonprosecutor.org/about/staff): The office's prosecutors
- [Victim's Advocate](https://kentonprosecutor.org/about/victims-advocate): Support for victims of crime
- [What We Do](https://kentonprosecutor.org/services): Statutory duties and services
